changes.reason: Repair the static source-to-metadata contract for Component import bindings and scope. TypeScript becomes an explicit scanner dependency; existing Node filesystem access remains build/tooling behavior. No deployment Host, Provider, credentials, storage or lifecycle contract changes.

kubernetes.reason: The change repairs static source-to-intent-map metadata before application deployment. It adds no Host, Provider, deployment profile or runtime capability for Kubernetes Node applications; the catalog remains unclaimed.
constraints: Source discovery requires Node filesystem access and TypeScript during build/tooling. It does not initialize deployed applications, change invocation/flush ownership, or certify a deployment host.
Direct public Component imports are recognized; local wrappers and application re-export barrels are not resolved.
